page.notes: Right column end: the last word of the page, "nomi-", is hyphenated and continues on the next page. Several Roman numerals and section marks are small and uneven (e.g. "2.48", "8e.c.", "lz", "†"); transcribed as printed but may be misread from the scan. "hinibus" is a doubtful reading (probably "finibus"), marked [?]. Ink show-through and a small dot at the bottom centre are not printed text and were omitted.
